units.source_text: 此后源氏公子郁郁寡欢。

en.t: After this, Prince Genji was sunk in melancholy.

units.source_text: 戒荤茹素，笼闭一室，终日不卷珠帘，一心诵经念佛。

en.t: He gave up meat and lived on vegetarian fare, shut himself away in one room, kept the beaded blinds lowered all day, and devoted himself entirely to reciting sutras and invoking the Buddha.

units.source_text: 他常常派人去慰问前斋宫。

en.t: He often sent people to ask after the former High Priestess.

units.source_text: 前斋宫心情渐渐安静，也常亲自作复。

en.t: The former High Priestess gradually regained her composure, and she too often wrote replies in her own hand.

units.source_text: 她起初怕羞，但乳母等劝导她，说央人代复是失礼的，她只得自己动笔了。

en.t: At first she was shy, but her nurses and others advised her that it would be discourteous to have someone else answer for her, so she had no choice but to take up the brush herself.
